metadata.title: [CF-DATAPLANE] Downstream and upstream transport security with tls
metadata.author: dawid-nowak

description:
Enable secure transport protocol to upstream and downstream components using static configuration.
1. The dataplane should be able to start on two different ports.
2. To secure the downstream channel the dataplane should be able to use a certificate/key configured at startime via CLI or env variable.
3. To secure the upstream channel the dataplane should be able to use a system trust store and and also use certificates from the bundle passed via CLI.
4. Optionally, on the upstream channel, the dataplane should be able to send an identity derived from the parameters passed on the command line to ensure that mTLS is working correctly.
